changes_from_v1_1: limits use flow-adjusted returns: period_return = value_before_deposit / previous decision value - 1, unit_index compounds it, unit_peak = running max; daily_loss iff period_return < -3%, drawdown iff unit_index < 85% of unit_peak
any limit sets no_buy for the next execution (no new buy and no top-up); drawdown also forces weight 0 (flatten) and writes a pause row
paper mode credits 10,000 won per decision session as a paper_deposit row, mirroring the backtest's deposit per close; the live account's real deposits are the owner's
top-up buys stated: while held with weight 1 and no limit, cash above the holding is invested at the next open (all-in rule)
every decision stores a dated snapshot of the operating series (data/kr_etf/snapshots/live_daily_{raw,adj}_<day>_<hhmmss>.json) with sha256, so past decisions can be reproduced
live order anomaly (status not FILLED after the 90 s wait) writes a pause row and alerts
scope: the KR daily loop on 069500 (KODEX 200) only; paper mode by default; live only after the owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel

capital.account: owner's Toss KR account cash plus the daily 10,000 won refill (paper: paper_deposit row per decision session)
capital.position: either all cash or all-in 069500 (integer shares affordable with fee); while held with weight 1 and no limit, new cash is invested at the next open (top-up); no leverage, no short, no derivatives

signal.rule: EMA ribbon 8 > 21 > 50 > 200 on adjusted closes from the series origin 2002-10-14 (rule core 09d0cf42 rejects any other start): weight 1 when fully stacked, else 0
signal.decision_time: 15:35 KST on each trading session, only on a completed daily bar (fetched after 15:31); the wrapper refuses to decide before 15:31:00 and records too_early; the operating series was seeded from the frozen files with trailing incomplete rows dropped (bar complete iff fetched >= day 15:31:00 KST)
signal.execution: next trading session inside 09:00:30..09:10:00 KST only (outside: execution_skip, no order); the pending decision must come from the most recent trading session: if a weekday between the decision day and today has a traded daily candle, the decision is stale and skipped; market buy of the affordable integer quantity when weight 1, not no_buy; market sell of the whole holding when weight 0 and held; nothing otherwise
signal.evidence: retrospective ledger 2014-12-30..2026-11-05: +48,095,602 won (99.5% from 2025-2026), max drawdown -14,865,836, exposure 39%, TWR +200.9% (always-long +243.4%), unit drawdown -24.5% (always-long -42.9%); plateau and delay/cost stress passed on the same history; one same-data history, not a forward guarantee

limits.daily_loss: coded: period_return < -3% -> no_buy for the next execution (no new buy, no top-up); an existing holding follows the rule weight
limits.drawdown: coded: unit_index < 85% of unit_peak -> weight 0 (flatten at the next open), no_buy, pause row; while paused the loop records paused_skip at 15:35 and skips any non-flatten execution; only the owner resumes with dobby_kr.py resume
limits.order_anomaly: coded (live only): order status not FILLED after the 90 s wait -> pause row and alert
kill_switch: stale data: no complete bar by 15:40 or no orderbook at execution -> no order, alert
stale decision: a traded session between the decision and the execution day -> no order
drawdown and order anomaly: pause as above
limits.broker_side: where Toss allows, set an account-level daily order cap for 069500 equal to the loop's size; this is a wall, the loop's checks are only rules

records.ledger: runs/dobby_kr_ledger.jsonl append-only: loop_start, paper_init, paper_deposit, decision (EMAs, trend, w_rule, w, limits, no_buy, period_return, unit_index, unit_peak, value_before_deposit, deposit, value, series_snapshot), execution (ask/bid, quantity, fee, or action none with reason), execution_skip with reason, too_early, paused_skip, pause, resume, revision, error
records.snapshots: data/kr_etf/snapshots/: the operating raw and adjusted series as used for each decision, sha256 in the decision row
records.channel: one line per decision and per execution in #bigmoney; alerts (limits, stale decision, pause, revision) immediately
records.weekly: every Sunday 18:00 KST: paper/live results vs the rule core applied to the snapshot series for the same sessions (consistency check), posted to the channel

promotion_ladder.name: paper
promotion_ladder.condition_to_advance: 10 trading sessions logged with every decision matching the rule core applied to the snapshot series (zero mismatches) AND bill's wrapper review items closed; the 10-session match is necessary, not sufficient

promotion_ladder.name: live
promotion_ladder.condition: owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel after rung 1 evidence is posted
promotion_ladder.capital: the account as is (small); no size ramp needed

promotion_ladder.name: review
promotion_ladder.condition: every Sunday; demote to paper on any kill-switch trigger or a rule-code change until the change is reviewed

change_control: the rule, its parameters and the limits change only by a new spec with hashes reviewed by bill; no parameter change after seeing live results without a written spec
not_covered: the research council axes (T, Fly, Jev) until they pass their own gates

KRX holiday calendar: a holiday between the decision and the execution is inferred only from the provider's daily candles (no candle on the weekday = not a session); a provider gap would be misread as a holiday

live flows: in live mode the owner's real deposits are not separated from returns, so the live limits would mis-measure period_return until a deposit record exists (paper mode is exact because the paper_deposit row is known)
